text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Passing the 400-meter mark!! Which 
Umamusume will burst to the front?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: To become the best in Japan—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I will become oneeeeee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Haha!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOOOOHHHHHH!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Stay Gold!! Stay Gold 
crosses the line in first place!!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Stay Golllld! Congrats!! Stego really is 
the strongest after all!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Stego's at the pinnacle of this era!! 
Thank you for proving it to us all!!
Stego-san!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Spe...—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations on becoming the best in 
Japan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Stego-san really is strong after all...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I truly felt... that this is the very 
center of our era...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (Ah... I see――――)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(It's missing from my journey. The things 
that should have been there, both before 
and after that "Japan Cup.")

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(That's why, to the audience... To Spe... 
I am no longer—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
..............................I suppose 
that's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(That belongs to a different world. And 
the one who won today... is me.)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Because you were truly strong... I was 
able to run today, striving to surpass 
you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Could you make me one promise?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A promise...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Please don't give up on becoming the best 
in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Because you're a horse girl who's bound to 
become the Supreme Commander of Japan 
someday.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Supreme Commander of Japan...—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
……Understood. I will become the best in 
Japan, without fail!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And I'll prove it to everyone! As Japan's 
Supreme Commander, Special Week!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (That's why I'll take it with me, too.)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(The glory I gained by defeating you 
today... and these feelings—)
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's a glory that we seized 
together.

text_block_list.name: Stego's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Stegooo!! Prove that you're the strongest 
at the Arima Kinen, toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Stego's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely be cheering for you!! Win 
the Arima Kinen, too, okay?!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "Arima Kinen"————

Before I knew it, Stay Gold and I were 
standing in a place I had never seen 
before. Was this a daydream, or—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ……It's a path.

Where Stay Gold's gaze was fixed. There 
lay two paths stretching straight out into 
the distance.

One path stretched far toward the golden 
horizon—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ......It's the same color.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The end of my other-world self... that I 
saw in my "memories."
And the other path is—

"It swirls into something indiscernible, 
extending into a colossal chaos..."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――...A light.

Where Stay Gold pointed, several flickers 
of light could be seen twinkling amidst 
the chaos.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: That is... that color is...—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ......Well, I'll just leave it be.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, right now, I need to 
live up to the expectations of those who 
watched over me.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "Everyone!! Thanks for cheering me on!!"
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

And so, amidst everyone's blessings, Stay 
Gold's Japan Cup drew to a close—
—That night.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Do you remember what you saw in the 
Winner's Circle?
choice_data_list: Yeah. But what on earth was that—
Yeah. But what on earth was that—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I guess the time has come to choose.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Where should the destination of this 
journey be set?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...One of them was the path she originally 
aimed for.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The place another me from another world 
once reached. The edge of "memory"—the 
land of Hong Kong.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: And the other one is—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
A path of chaos, where anything can 
happen.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yet amidst that chaos... there is a light 
that flickers with certainty.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Surely, that is the brilliance of those 
bound to me by fate.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Where they all gather in the end... is the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Which way do you want to go?

"...The policy for this journey has 
remained unchanged from the very 
beginning."

If that is where causality converges. If 
that is where the unknown chaos lies.
choice_data_list: Let's go. — To the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.text:
I am convinced. That very race will make 
this journey the most exciting of all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……Reaching the end of those "memories" 
with who I am now was something I yearned 
for a little, but――

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...This suits us much better.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Let us go. —And let us enjoy it together.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, where anything can 
happen.

...At the convergence of woven destinies. 
What awaits the traveler is—
